Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 훈련에 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 재시도할 거냐고 묻는다. 뭐라고 얘기할까?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After failing the training, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> is asking if she should try again. What should I say?
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: トレーニングに失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>が再挑戦するかどうか尋ねる。何と声をかけようか？
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 训练失败的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>问要不要再试一次。该说什么好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 訓練失敗的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>問要不要再試一次。該說什麼好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir échoué à l'entraînement, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> demande si elle doit réessayer. Que devrais-je dire ?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nach dem gescheiterten Training fragt <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, ob sie es noch einmal versuchen soll. Was soll ich sagen?
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> falló el entrenamiento y pregunta si debe intentarlo de nuevo. ¿Qué debo decir?
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Depois de falhar no treinamento, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> pergunta se deve tentar novamente. O que devo dizer?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ล้มเหลวในการฝึก ถามว่าจะลองอีกครั้งดีไหม จะพูดว่าอะไรดีครับ/คะ?
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> gagal dalam latihan dan bertanya apakah dia harus mencoba lagi. Apa yang harus kukatakan?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thất bại trong buổi huấn luyện và hỏi liệu mình có nên thử lại không. Tôi nên nói gì đây?
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: प्रशिक्षण में असफल होने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> पूछ रही है कि क्या उसे फिर से कोशिश करनी चाहिए। मुझे क्या कहना चाहिए?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: You'll hurt yourself if you push yourself too hard.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Si tu te forces, tu vas te blesser.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Wenn du dich überanstrengst, ist es gefährlich.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Si te esfuerzas demasiado, te harás daño.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: É perigoso se você se esforçar demais.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ถ้าฝืนมากเกินไปจะอันตรายนะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Nếu cố quá, cậu sẽ bị thương đấy.

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: よし。もう一度やってみよう！
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ได้เลย! ลองอีกครั้ง!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Được thôi. Thử lại lần nữa nào!

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ยื่นยาเพิ่มพลังให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đưa cho cô ấy một bình Thuốc Sức Sống.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングをここまでにし、休むことにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé d'arrêter l'entraînement et de se reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, das Training zu beenden und sich auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió dejar de entrenar y descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu parar o treinamento e descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตัดสินใจหยุดฝึกและพักผ่อน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk mengakhiri latihan dan beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quyết định dừng huấn luyện và nghỉ ngơi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने प्रशिक्षण समाप्त करने और आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 아쉬움이 남아있는 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though she decided to rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed unsatisfied.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 休むことにしたが、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、物足りなさを感じているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然决定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎还有些遗憾。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然決定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎還有些遺憾。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Bien qu'elle ait décidé de se reposer, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait toujours avoir des regrets.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl sie beschloss, sich auszuruhen, schien <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> immer noch unzufrieden zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Embora tenha decidido descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ainda parecia insatisfeita.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้จะตัดสินใจพักผ่อนแล้ว แต่ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ยังดูไม่พอใจ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun dia memutuskan untuk beristirahat, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> masih terlihat tidak puas.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Dù đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi, nhưng <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn có vẻ không hài lòng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हालांकि उसने आराम करने का फैसला किया, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अभी भी असंतुष्ट लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again and achieved solid results.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦し、成果を上げた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑战训练并取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑戰訓練並取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé et a obtenu des résultats solides.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut im Training und erzielte solide Ergebnisse.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> volvió a entrenar y tuvo éxito.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente e obteve resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ลองฝึกอีกครั้งและได้ผลลัพธ์ที่ดี
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi dan mencapai hasil yang solid.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thử lại và đạt được kết quả khả quan.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की और ठोस परिणाम हासिल किए।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again but failed once more.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦したが、失敗した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé mais a échoué une fois de plus.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut im Training, scheiterte aber wieder.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo, pero volvió a fallar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente, mas falhou mais uma vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ลองฝึกอีกครั้งแต่ก็ล้มเหลวอีก
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi tetapi gagal sekali lagi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thử lại nhưng một lần nữa thất bại.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की लेकिन एक बार फिर असफल रही।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, son visage s'est illuminé après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ดีใจที่ได้รับโพชั่น
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menjadi ceria setelah menerima ramuan itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã vui vẻ hơn sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> औषधि मिलने के बाद खुश हो गई।
